entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Razor formatting not honoring Visual Studio formatting options for C# code blocks within .razor files #84608
  • Ensure Visual Basic SDK samples are strict #84607
    .NET 11
  • Razor formatting error #84601

Closed

  • [Known Build Error] Pool leak detected #83972
    18.9
  • IDE0031: false positive when identifier is ambiguous between variable and type #82281
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12022.198 #84596

PullRequests

Created

  • Compiler: Guard EditorConfig section matching recursion #84606
  • Run Razor decl C# lowering before tag-helper discovery (classify-first component split) #84605
    Area-Razor
  • Fix duplicate `SyntaxNodeAction`s for union declarations and its members #84604
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Unsafe evolution: ensure diagnostics are picked up by IDE #84603
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Unsafe evolution: relax `safe` modifier placement restrictions #84602
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix IL3000: guard Assembly.Location access behind RuntimeFeature.IsDynamicCodeSupported #84599

Merged

  • Avoid nullref when opening XAML documents with no view adapter #84595
  • CI desktop test jobs: run Release_64 instead of Release_32 on PRs. Delete Debug_32 job. #84598
  • Fix false positive with Color Color static member access #84533
    VSCode
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3029275 #84597

Updated

  • Do not report hidden pattern diagnostics #84576
  • Nullable annotate Symbol.ContainingType #84536
    Area-Compilers
  • Implement LSP daemon mode #84199
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Add on-demand project loading #84591
    VSCode
  • Add plan-first working loop to Copilot instructions #84532
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Upgrade integration tests to vs18 #81758
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Unions: cache some calculated results on NamedTypeSymbol representing a union type #84589
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Allow MSBuildWorkspace to open file-based apps #84139
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Feature - Run File
  • Fix: LINQ implicit anonymous type property allows ref structs, causing runtime TypeLoadException #84485
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #83901
    Area-Infrastructure, Needs API Review
  • Use vscode-uri semantics for parsing URIs #83593
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Area-Razor
